headline: Al Qasr Al Ghamedh (Al Qassimi Palace) in Ras Al-Khaimah, United Arab Emirates

items.title: Al Qasr Al Ghamedh (Al Qassimi Palace) in Ras Al-Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
items.summary: Sitting upon one of the hills in Ras Al Khaimah, Al Qasimi Palace, also known as Al Qasr Al Ghamedh (the Haunted Palace), is one of the UAE's most fascinating landmarks. Commissioned by the late Sheikh Abdulaziz bin Humaid Al Qasimi, construction began in 1975 and took years to complete. Although the palace was built as a grand private residence, it remained largely unoccupied for around 35 years.
